invariants.rationale: The minimum number of node actors added is 1, either via the base case or the sum of recursive cases.
The return value is always at least 1 (base case for non-expanded), but may be greater if 'expanded' is true and children are added.
The sum of the input actorIndex and the return value should never be less than the original actorIndex.
actorIndex appears to be a non-negative index used for insertion into a tree.
tree is dereferenced in the method body, so it must be non-null at method exit.
